statement: WITH tx AS (SELECT CAST(row_id AS STRING) row_id, CAST(account_id AS STRING) account_id, CAST(event_time AS BIGINT) event_time, CAST(amount AS DOUBLE) amount, CAST(currency AS STRING) currency FROM read_files('/Volumes/workspace/mlpabf20644/raw3bde51/transactions.csv', format => 'csv', header => true)), fx AS (SELECT CAST(currency AS STRING) currency, CAST(fx_rate AS DOUBLE) fx_rate FROM read_files('/Volumes/workspace/mlpabf20644/raw3bde51/fx_rates.csv', format => 'csv', header => true)), expected AS (SELECT a.row_id, a.account_id, a.event_time, a.amount * f.fx_rate AS amount_usd, CASE WHEN date_format(convert_timezone('UTC', timestamp_millis(a.event_time)), 'E') IN ('Sat','Sun') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_weekend, (SELECT SUM(b.amount) FROM tx b WHERE b.account_id = a.account_id AND b.event_time BETWEEN a.event_time - 604800000 AND a.event_time) AS amount_7d FROM tx a JOIN fx f ON a.currency = f.currency) SELECT COUNT(*) AS mismatches FROM expected e JOIN workspace.mlpabf20644.features3bde51 g ON e.row_id = g.row_id WHERE g.account_id <> e.account_id OR g.event_time <> e.event_time OR ABS(g.amount_usd - e.amount_usd) > 1e-9 OR g.is_weekend <> e.is_weekend OR ABS(g.amount_7d - e.amount_7d) > 1e-9
